title: Why Linux is making a comeback on desktop

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know Linux is now used by 3% of all desktop users?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It's not just for developers anymore — it's getting mainstream.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Linux is an open-source operating system that's free and customizable.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: New versions like GNOME 46 are making the UI more user-friendly.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Gamers, designers, and even businesses are switching to Linux.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Linux is faster, more secure, and cheaper than Windows.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Try it out — what's stopping you from switching today?
